title: Iran Formally Condemns U.S. Sweeping Sanctions as 'Unjust Economic Pressure'
detail: Iran issued a formal condemnation of U.S. plans to announce new sweeping sanctions against the country, characterizing the measures as unjust economic pressure. The denunciation signals continued deterioration of diplomatic relations amid ongoing tensions over nuclear negotiations and regional policy disputes.

title: Iran Executes January 2026 Protest Detainee Majid Adineh
detail: Iran executed Majid Adineh at dawn in Karaj, more than seven months after his arrest during the January 2026 nationwide protests in the city's Mohammadshahr area. The Karaj Revolutionary Court had convicted him of 'operational actions' on behalf of Israel and the United States and ordered confiscation of his property; the Supreme Court upheld the sentence on appeal. Human rights monitors say the case relied on forced confessions and secret proceedings, with no public information released on his access to legal counsel. Adineh is the 29th individual executed in connection with the January 2026 protests since March 2026.

media.caption: Majid Adineh was executed in Karaj after being convicted over the January 2026 protests
